headline: Nicolas Papadopoulo Named President and Chief Underwriting Officer of Arch Capital Group Ltd.
summary:
New Role is Effective Jan. 1, 2021

Arch Capital Group Ltd. [NASDAQ: ACGL] today announced that Nicolas Papadopoulo will be promoted to the position of President and Chief Underwriting Officer, effective Jan. 1, 2021. Papadopoulo joined Arch in 2001 and currently serves as Chairman and CEO of Arch Worldwide Insurance Group and Chief Underwriting Officer for Property and Casualty Operations.
